details.description:
You see a humanoid shape cast on the cavern wall, outlined among the rocks and odd fungus growing there. With a flash of insight, you realize the cavern is trying to steal your shadow. You must eat the fungus to reclaim your shadow!

Festering Haunt: This haunt only effects those haunted by Vorel Foxgovs and his painful death by a thousand necromantic diseases. If no creatures in a group are haunted by Vorel Foxglove, this haunt may tangot any creatire in a group.
details.reset: Though tho fungus can be temporarily disabled by fire or application of holy water, it will rsset in 24 hours if not disabled via a counteract check against a level 3 spell effect from dispel magic or by succeeding in two DC23 expert checks in a row in Religion, Oocultism, Nature or Arcana.

Contagious Reaction R Trigger A Creature ic touching the fungus. A Creature who touched the fungus is exposed to Vorels Potent Plague. A Creature that ingests the fungus takes a -2 circumstance penalty to the fortitude saving throw to avoid contracting the disease.
